name: key_bar
description: A row of up to 10 clickable function keys like the F1 Help F2 Setup bar at the bottom of htop. Each key can run an action.

config.name: key_count
config.label: Number of Keys
config.description: How many keys are shown, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 10

config.name: key_1_key
config.label: Key
config.description: The short key name of key 1

config.name: key_1_label
config.label: Label
config.description: The text next to key 1

config.name: key_1_action
config.label: Action
config.description: The action to run when key 1 is clicked

config.name: label_width
config.label: Label Width
config.description: The minimum width of each label in characters. Defaults to 6

config.name: hide_fill
config.label: Don't Fill Width
config.description: By default the label color fills the rest of the line like in htop

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The widget width decides how many characters fit

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: key_color
config.label: Key Text
config.description: The text color of the keys
